signature.name: VTask.strongInduction
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} -> (H : (s : Finset α) → ((t : Finset α) → t ⊂ s → p t) → p s) -> (s : Finset α) -> p s

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.strongInduction is a total function with no junk-value conventions; every input is meaningful and the recursion terminates by well-founded induction on finset cardinality.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {p : Finset α → Sort*} (H : ∀ s : Finset α, (∀ t : Finset α, t ⊂ s → p t) → p s) (s : Finset α), VTask.strongInduction H s = H s (fun t _ => VTask.strongInduction H t)

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {p : Finset α → Prop} (H : ∀ s : Finset α, (∀ t : Finset α, t ⊂ s → p t) → p s), VTask.strongInduction H ∅ = H ∅ (fun t ht => absurd ht (Finset.not_ssubset_empty t))
